snippet.title: Bankiye Naarey - The Graceful Maiden (Official Video) | Satinder Sartaaj | J Sandeep |  Punjabi Song
snippet.description:
#satindersartaaj  #BankiyeNaarey  

Presenting “Bankiye Naarey - The Graceful Maiden, from the album “The Perfumed Moments.”
🎵 Song Credits

🎶 Song: ਬਾਂਕੀਏ ਨਾਰੇ Bankiye Naarey 
{ The Graceful Maiden }
💿 Album: The Perfumed Moments
✍️🎙️ Lyrics / Composer / Singer: Satinder Sartaaj
🎧 Music: Beat Minister
🎚️ Mix / Master: Sameer Charegaonkar
🎥 Director: Josan Sandeep
🎬 Edit & DI: Gurmeet Singh Dhaliwal
👩🏻 Female Model: Homaira Khan

ਬਾਂਕੀਏ ਨਾਰੇ BANKIYE NAAREY
 { The Graceful Maiden }

ਤੇਰਾ ਆਉਣਾ ਜੀਕਣ ਬਾਰਿਸ਼ ਹੋਵੇ ਰੇਤੇ ‘ਤੇ ।
ਤੇਰਾ ਆਉਣਾ ਕਵਿਤਾ ਵਰਗਾ ਖਾਲੀ ਚੇਤੇ ‘ਤੇ ।
ਜਿਉਂ ਪਰੀ ਕੋਈ ਰੱਬ ਬੱਦਲ਼ੋਂ ਆਪ ਉਤਾਰੇ ਨੀ ।
ਤੇਰੀ ਝਲਕ ਨੇ ਬਦਲੇ ਰੰਗ ਬਾਂਕੀਏ ਨਾਰੇ ਨੀ ।
ਮੇਰੇ ਦਿਲ ਦੀ ਧੜਕਣ ਤੇਜ਼ ਹੋਈ ਮੁਟਿਆਰੇ ਨੀ ।
ਤੇਰੀ ਝਲਕ ਨੇ ਬਦਲੇ ਰੰਗ ਬਾਂਕੀਏ ਨਾਰੇ ਨੀ ।

Your arrival was like rain falling upon a desert of sand.
Your arrival was like poetry written across an empty memory.
As though God Himself had lowered fairy from the clouds.
One glimpse of you transformed every colour, O graceful maiden.
The rhythm of my heart grew suddenly faster, O beautiful one.
One glimpse of you transformed every colour, O graceful maiden.

ਸਿਖਰ ਦੁਪਿਹਰੇ ਧਰਤੀ ‘ਤੇ ਜਿਉਂ ਹੋਰ ਵੀ ਚਾਨਣ ਹੋ ਗਿਆ ਸੀ ।
ਤੇਜ਼ ਹਵਾਵਾਂ ਵਗਦੀਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਜਿਉਂ ਹਰ ਇੱਕ ਪੱਤ ਖਲੋ ਗਿਆ ਸੀ ।
ਨਾ-ਮੁਮਕਿਨ ਦਿਸਣੇ ਐਸੇ ਅਜਬ ਨਜ਼ਾਰੇ ਨੀ ।

It was as though the earth grew even brighter at the height of noon.
As though every leaf stood still despite the rushing winds.
Such impossible, wondrous sights seemed to unfold before my eyes.


ਪਗਡੰਡੀਆਂ ਸੁੰਨੀਆਂ-ਸੁੰਨੀਆਂ ‘ਤੇ ਕਦਮ ਤੇਰੇ ਦੀ ਆਹਟ ਨੇ ।
ਤਰਬਾਂ ਏਸ ਵਜੂਦ ਦੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਛੇੜਿਆ ਜਿਉਂ ਝਰਨਾਹਟ ਨੇ ।
ਬੇ-ਖ਼ਬਰ ਮੈਂ ਜਾਵਾਂ ਕਿਸ-ਕਿਸ ਤੋਂ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੇ ਨੀ ।

Upon those lonely, deserted footpaths echoed the whisper of your footsteps.
Like tremor of this ecstasy ; touched every hidden string of my being.
Unaware of myself, I scarcely knew whom or what I should stand in awe of.


ਕਿੰਨੇ ਖ਼ੁਸ਼ਕਿਸਮਤ ਨੇ ਜਿਹੜੇ ਇਸ ਅਹਿਸਾਸ ਨੂੰ ਮਾਣਦੇ ਨੇ ।
ਦਿਨ ਤੇ ਰਾਤ ਵਿਚਲੀਆਂ ਅਣਮੁੱਲੀਆਂ ਘੜੀਆਂ ਪਹਿਚਾਣਦੇ ਨੇ ।
ਫੁੱਲ ਖਿੜਦੇ ਉਦੋਂ ਮੋਹੱਬਤ ਜਦ ਮੱਤ ਮਾਰੇ ਨੀ ।

How fortunate are those who are blessed to experience such a feeling.
Who recognize those priceless moments that dwell between day and night.
Flowers bloom when love gently overpowers reason.


ਐਸੀ ਸੂਰਤ ਵੇਖ ਕੇ ਵਾਜਿਬ ਸੁਰਤਾਂ ਦਾ ਗੁੰਮ ਹੋਣਾ ਜੀ ।
ਵਾਜਿਬ ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਸ਼ਾਯਰ ਬਣ ਜਾਏ ਸਿੱਖ ਜਾਏ ਵਕ਼ਤ ਪਰੋਣਾ ਜੀ ।
ਇਉਂ ਕੁਦਰਤ ਖ਼ੁਦ ਸਰਤਾਜ ਦੇ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਨੀ ।

A face so enchanting can rightly make one lose all senses .
It is only natural that one becomes a poet & learns to weave moments into verse.
Such is the way Nature herself comes to the aid of Sartaaj’s art.

snippet.title: Candy Stripers (1978) [Quality X & Mélusine Blu-ray Promo Trailer]
snippet.description:
Candy Stripers is available now on Blu-ray from Quality X and Mélusine!

At City Hospital, the traditional therapeutic ethos of the "laying on of hands" is in no danger of disappearing. The lovely young candy stripers Pam, Sharon, and Cindy labor to ensure every patient receives specialized and highly personal treatment, always delivered with the most detailed bedside manner. Their eager allegiance to the hippocratic oath doesn't stop with just the patients: the entire hospital staff benefits from their tender loving care. As much as these providers of extra-sensual healthcare enjoy their work, it's regularly at risk of being spoiled by the pesky and uptight Sarge, their staff coordinator. Since it's Sharon's last day on the job, the entire hospital staff has organized a big farewell bash, which promises to be a real ball -- that is, unless Sarge spoils the fun.

One of famed director Bob Chinn's (Hot & Saucy Pizza Girls) most popular and successful erotic films, CANDY STRIPERS is a scorching, non-stop bombardment of outrageous carnality and brisk comedy. Starring Amber Hunt (Cry For Cindy) in the most notorious performance of her career, along with Sharon Thorpe (SexWorld), Cris Cassidy (Sadie), Nancy Hoffman (Dracula Sucks), Paul Thomas (Autobiography of a Flea), Joey Silvera (Femmes DeSade), and Richard Pacheco (High School Memories) in his screen debut, it also boasts a rollicking score written and performed for the film. Quality X is eager to wheel out this oft-censored curative classic, entirely uncut and newly restored in 4K from its original 35mm camera negative, complete with extensive new interviews with Chinn and Pacheco.

snippet.title: Hear “Highway to Hell” Before Its Release | AC/DC at Day on the Green 1979
snippet.description:
Experience an ultra-rare, lightning-in-a-bottle moment in hard rock history. Welcome to the official live music archives, presenting a beautifully restored, high-definition broadcast of AC/DC delivering a blistering, high-voltage performance of "Highway to Hell"—played live for a massive festival crowd days before the legendary album was even released!

Recorded live on July 21, 1979, at legendary promoter Bill Graham’s "Day on the Green" festival at the Oakland Coliseum in California, this pristine archival recording captures the Australian titans at the absolute peak of the Bon Scott era. Playing under the blazing summer sun, the band unleashed their brand-new, soon-to-be-immortal anthem on an unsuspecting crowd. Driven by Angus Young's manic energy and Bon Scott's unparalleled, swaggering frontman charisma, this performance shows exactly how AC/DC conquered America.

📅 July 13, 1979

🚀 The Lineup:

🎤 Bon Scott – Lead Vocals
🎸 Angus Young – Lead Guitar
🎸 Malcolm Young – Rhythm Guitar, Backing Vocals
🎸 Cliff Williams – Bass Guitar, Backing Vocals
🥁 Phil Rudd – Drums

Highway to Hell reached number 17 on the US Billboard 200 and has been certified 7x Platinum by the RIAA, signifying over 7 million copies sold in the United States alone.

📋 5 Fast Facts About the Performance:

• **The Pre-Release Premiere** – This July 21, 1979 performance took place just days before the *Highway to Hell* album officially hit record store shelves on July 27 (and two weeks before its US release). The massive Oakland crowd was witnessing the birth of a global hard rock anthem in real-time.
• **Stealing the Show** – Bill Graham's "Day on the Green" was a mammoth stadium festival featuring heavyweights like Aerosmith, Ted Nugent, and Journey. Despite being billed lower on the poster, AC/DC’s ferocity and unapologetic volume famously stole the show, cementing their status as an arena-ready juggernaut.
• **Bon Scott's Final US Tour** – This concert was part of the grueling 1979 North American tour, which tragically proved to be Bon Scott's final run in the United States before his untimely death in February 1980. This footage captures him at the absolute zenith of his vocal and performative powers.
• **The Mutt Lange Era Begins** – "Highway to Hell" marked the band's first collaboration with legendary producer Robert John "Mutt" Lange. While they retained their gritty, pub-rock roots, the track's massive, hook-driven chorus signaled their transition into global radio superstars.
• **Malcolm's Rhythm Engine** – While Angus Young's duck-walking schoolboy theatrics demand visual attention, this performance is a masterclass in the rock-solid rhythm section. Malcolm Young's driving, heavy right hand on the rhythm guitar anchors the song, allowing Angus to completely lose his mind on stage.

#ACDC #HighwayToHell #ClassicRock #LiveConcert #RockHistory
